title: Automatic Pre-Deadline Squad Sync
changes: Adds a one-time installable userscript that syncs the authenticated FPL Pick Team squad on load, focus, visibility changes, and a bounded timer.
Uses revocable entry-scoped pairing tokens, stores only SHA-256 token hashes, and accepts squad contracts only from the official FPL browser origin.
Shows the last confirmed squad sync time in Planning while retaining the bookmarklet as a manual fallback.

title: Unified Transfer Decision Support
changes: Replaces the dashboard's separate one-Gameweek optimizer with the balanced five-Gameweek Planning scenario.
Shows the recommended sell and buy, expected gain, bank, points hit, squad source, freshness, and model version.
Explains a genuine hold decision and surfaces recoverable errors instead of claiming an empty result means the squad is optimal.

title: Planning Bundle Cache Recovery
changes: Forces a fresh Planning workspace bundle so production cannot reuse the stale pre-fix client artifact.
Restores post-deadline Planning rendering with the guarded numeric displays introduced in 0.6.14.

title: Post-Deadline Planning Data Compatibility
changes: Handles official public picks that omit pre-deadline selling prices by falling back to each player's current FPL price.
Versions corrected projections separately so previously invalid persisted scenarios cannot be reused.
Guards numeric Planning displays so malformed upstream metrics show a placeholder instead of crashing the workspace.

title: Reproducible Planning and My Plan Evaluation
changes: Persists immutable, content-hashed FPL and entry snapshots with versioned scenarios, constraints, projections, and decisions.
Replaces device-only My Plan state with authenticated server persistence and scenario ownership validation.
Freezes selected decisions at the deadline and evaluates finalized plans against official points, captaincy, and squad outcomes.

title: Post-Gameweek Planning Lifecycle
changes: Targets the upcoming manageable Gameweek while keeping the latest published squad as the planning baseline.
Uses a fresh confirmed import for private pre-deadline squad changes instead of silently reverting to the previous Gameweek's public picks.
Shows the source and target Gameweeks clearly in Planning and covers preseason, post-GW1, and final-Gameweek boundaries.

title: Intermittent Outage Detection
changes: Marks a health check that succeeds only after a retry as degraded and preserves its failure diagnostics.
Retains scheduled health history and escalates when two of the latest three checks recover from initial failures.
Keeps isolated transient failures as visible GitHub warnings while sustained outages continue to fail immediately.

title: Resilient Production Health Monitoring
changes: Retries transient production health failures with a bounded backoff before raising an alert.
Includes the final health response body in failure diagnostics for faster incident triage.
Adds focused coverage for transient HTTP failures, sustained outages, and network errors.

title: Launch Operations and Recovery
changes: Adds database readiness and the active confirmed-import lifecycle to production health and smoke checks.
Keeps official public picks available if the saved-import store is temporarily degraded and improves pre-deadline recovery guidance.
Adds hourly production monitoring plus a deadline-day verification, recovery, privacy, and rollback runbook.

title: Durable Confirmed Squad Lifecycle
changes: Saves a reviewed authenticated squad server-side so Planning can use it across tabs and signed-in sessions.
Supports explicit refresh, replacement, and clearing while automatically expiring the import after the Gameweek deadline.
Prefers official public Gameweek picks as soon as FPL releases them, retaining the saved squad only as a pre-deadline fallback.

title: Scenario Risk-Range Clarity
changes: Reports Floor, Balanced, and Upside points using their conservative, expected, and ceiling objectives.
Detects when all risk profiles genuinely converge on the same move, lineup, and captain.
Explains robust convergence instead of presenting identical recommendations as artificial alternatives.

title: Confirmed Squad Scenario Planning
changes: Retains a confirmed import only within the current Safari tab and submits it to the authenticated planning API.
Validates entry ownership, freshness, player availability, position composition, club limits, and starting formation.
Generates scenarios from pre-deadline picks and models GW1 unlimited changes without points hits.

title: Local Squad Review and Confirmation
changes: Resolves imported player names, clubs, positions, and selling prices against a public cached catalogue.
Displays starting XI, bench order, captain, and vice captain before accepting the squad.
Keeps squad IDs fragment-local and confirmation tab-local with no durable persistence.

title: Complete Squad Bookmarklet
changes: Adds a discoverable current-squad import setup card to the Planning workspace.
Creates a Safari bookmarklet that normalizes the authenticated my-team response into contract version 1.
Validates the transported squad, clears fragment data immediately, and keeps persistence disabled pending review.

title: Authenticated Squad Import Contract
changes: Defines a minimal versioned contract for current squad, captaincy, prices, bank, chip, and transfer state.
Rejects duplicate players, invalid lineup positions, malformed values, and unexpected fields.
Adds a production contract-readiness endpoint while keeping import persistence disabled.

title: FPL Import Feasibility Probe
changes: Copies a Safari-compatible bookmarklet from a dedicated diagnostic page.
Reads only a minimal team summary from FPL's authenticated endpoints.
Returns data in the URL fragment, clears it immediately, and persists nothing.

title: Mobile Launch Readiness
changes: Completed the production mobile acceptance pass for the Planning workspace
Standardized Planning inputs, selectors, and actions on 44px minimum touch targets
Improved release badge and modal close-button accessibility on mobile
Stabilized the dashboard authentication-gate regression test

title: 2026–27 Planning Workspace Launch
changes: Added Floor, Balanced, and Upside five-Gameweek planning scenarios
Replaced raw entry cookies with revocable hashed server-side sessions
Added production readiness checks, migration foundations, and automated smoke testing
Added deployment-specific release identity using the Git commit and Vercel deployment ID

title: Next.js 16 Migration & Season Trajectory 2.0
changes: Migrated Middleware to the new Next.js 16 Proxy convention (src/proxy.ts)
Resolved build failures by fixing deprecated request.ip API usage
Season Trajectory 2.0: Added Team Value tracking, Chip markers (WC, BB, TC, FH), and FPL Average benchmarks to the history chart
Merged origin/main branch features into master for unified production readiness
Added Transfer Optimizer UI and automated Transfer Evaluation cron job
Updated documentation to reflect new architecture and features

title: Consistency Pass, DGW UX, and Promotion Docs
changes: Standardized player visuals to current-season club shirts for a more consistent dashboard presentation
Completed double gameweek rendering in the fixture ticker and added a 'no DGW/BGW in next 5 GWs' indicator
Updated dashboard summary cards to show official/provisional/live GW score lifecycle and team value
Refreshed README and added product, architecture, and promotion-copy documentation
Applied additional UI cleanup for fixture and avatar presentation

title: Player Image Freshness & Visual Cleanup
changes: Added transfer-aware stale image filtering via /api/v1/player-photo
Use team_join_date intelligence: hide stale photos only for recently transferred players
Centralized player image URL routing through shared helper
Removed club-colored avatar border accents for a cleaner neutral presentation
Retained cache-busting and graceful transparent fallback for missing/broken images

title: Phase 3 Completion: Advanced Analytics
changes: Official Rank Integration: Dynamic toggle for Live vs. Official GW rank status
Enhanced Season Trajectory: Dual-axis Points/Rank line charts with log scaling
AI Captaincy Adviser: Integrated expected points (xP) analysis into the pitch
Fixture Heat-mapping: Club highlighting and form-based color coding in ticker
Refined Transfer Impact: Sorted analysis of hits vs. points gained
Hotfix: Resolved RankProjection dashboard build error

title: Squad Coverage Hotfix
changes: Include Bench players in Fixture Difficulty Ticker
Added visual 'Bench' separator to fixture table

title: Analytics Phase 3 & 4
changes: Real-time Mini-League Standings (Live rank shifts)
Live Rank Projection (Overall rank deltas)
Fixture Difficulty Ticker (Next 5 GW per player)
Enhanced Transfer Analyser (Sorting, Chips, Pts Impact)
Supabase Database Integration for full historical sync

title: Infrastructure Hub
changes: Next.js App Router migration
CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions & Vercel
Automated regression testing suite
Glassmorphism UI foundation

title: MVP Launch
changes: Initial FPL Dashboard release
Live Squad Pitch view
Basic Team ID authentication
